deck.audience: AI engineering leads and product managers evaluating LLM providers

brief.title: AI Model Landscape April 2026: Intelligence, Speed, and Pricing Benchmarks
brief.one_liner: Gemini 3.1 Pro and GPT-5.4 tie at 57 on the Intelligence Index while a 33x pricing gap separates the cheapest and most expensive frontier models.
brief.goal: Equip decision-makers with a clear, data-driven comparison of top LLMs across intelligence, throughput, and cost so they can select the right model for their use case.

slides.title: AI Model Landscape April 2026: Benchmarking Intelligence, Speed, and Cost Across 11 Frontier Models
slides.objective: Introduce the analysis scope and establish Artificial Analysis as the data source.

slides.title: Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview and GPT-5.4 Co-Lead the Intelligence Index at 57
slides.objective: Present the full intelligence ranking with scores for all 11 models, highlighting the two-way tie and the 57-to-33 spread.

slides.title: gpt-oss-120B Tops Output Speed at 218 Tokens/s -- More Than 4x Faster Than Claude Opus 4.6
slides.objective: Show the output-speed leaderboard (10 models with speed data; Muse Spark excluded) and emphasize the inverse relationship between intelligence and throughput.

slides.title: From $0.30 to $10 per Million Tokens: A 33x Pricing Gap Across Models
slides.objective: Compare per-token pricing across the 10 models with published pricing data (Muse Spark excluded) and surface the most cost-effective options for budget-sensitive deployments.

slides.title: No Model Wins on All Three Axes: Navigating the Intelligence-Efficiency-Cost Frontier
slides.objective: Use the intelligence-vs-output-tokens-consumed scatter plot and the proprietary vs. open-weight summary table to illustrate that every model requires trade-offs among intelligence, token efficiency, and cost, guiding the audience toward use-case-driven selection.

slides.title: Open Weights Close the Gap: GLM-5.1 Reaches 51 Intelligence at $2.10/M Tokens
slides.objective: Summarize key findings and actionable recommendations for model selection.
